text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- "We should all unite and build our country, the last to gain independence in the Balkans. The European option is our only option and final goal where I see the Macedonian people and where our country belongs," says Macedonian President Kiro Gligorov in first few minutes of New Year.

- Most citizens celebrating New Year in Skopje streets expressed hope and wish for better life. Thousands of Skopje citizens were in main square and many in restaurants but most celebrated New Year's Eve at home.
